mapper.select: SELECT museum_id AS museumId, object_id AS objectId, title, artist, artist_province AS artistProvince, dynasty, artist_wikidata_id AS artistWikidataId, artist_birth AS artistBirth, artist_death AS artistDeath, artist_bio AS artistBio, artist_wikipedia_summary AS artistWikipediaSummary, artist_enriched_at AS artistEnrichedAt, period, period_start_year AS periodStartYear, period_end_year AS periodEndYear, type, material, culture, description, provenance, bibliography, dimensions, museum, location, detail_url AS detailUrl, image_url AS imageUrl, iiif_manifest_url AS iiifManifestUrl, image_path AS imagePath, credit_line AS creditLine, accession_number AS accessionNumber, crawl_date AS crawlDate FROM artifact WHERE museum_id = #{museumId} AND object_id = #{objectId}

SELECT museum_id AS museumId, object_id AS objectId, title, artist, artist_province AS artistProvince, dynasty, artist_wikidata_id AS artistWikidataId, artist_birth AS artistBirth, artist_death AS artistDeath, artist_bio AS artistBio, artist_wikipedia_summary AS artistWikipediaSummary, artist_enriched_at AS artistEnrichedAt, period, period_start_year AS periodStartYear, period_end_year AS periodEndYear, type, material, culture, description, provenance, bibliography, dimensions, museum, location, detail_url AS detailUrl, image_url AS imageUrl, iiif_manifest_url AS iiifManifestUrl, image_path AS imagePath, credit_line AS creditLine, accession_number AS accessionNumber, crawl_date AS crawlDate FROM artifact LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artifact
SELECT dynasty AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE dynasty IS NOT NULL AND dynasty != '' GROUP BY dynasty ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE type IS NOT NULL AND type != '' GROUP BY type ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT museum AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE museum IS NOT NULL AND museum != '' GROUP BY museum ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT material AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE material IS NOT NULL AND material != '' GROUP BY material ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT location AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE location IS NOT NULL AND location != '' GROUP BY location ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dynasty) FROM artifact WHERE dynasty IS NOT NULL AND dynasty != ''
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT museum) FROM artifact WHERE museum IS NOT NULL AND museum != ''
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT type) FROM artifact WHERE type IS NOT NULL AND type != ''

SELECT museum_id AS museumId, object_id AS objectId, title, artist, dynasty, type, material, museum, location, image_url AS imageUrl, image_path AS imagePath FROM artifact WHERE dynasty = #{dynasty} LIMIT 50
SELECT YEAR(crawl_date) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE crawl_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY YEAR(crawl_date) ORDER BY name ASC
SELECT dynasty AS source, museum AS target, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE dynasty IS NOT NULL AND dynasty != '' AND museum IS NOT NULL AND museum != '' GROUP BY dynasty, museum
SELECT dynasty AS source, material AS target, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE dynasty IS NOT NULL AND dynasty != '' AND material IS NOT NULL AND material != '' GROUP BY dynasty, material
SELECT dynasty AS source, type AS target, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE dynasty IS NOT NULL AND dynasty != '' AND type IS NOT NULL AND type != '' GROUP BY dynasty, type
SELECT museum AS source, type AS target, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE museum IS NOT NULL AND museum != '' AND type IS NOT NULL AND type != '' GROUP BY museum, type
SELECT museum AS source, material AS target, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE museum IS NOT NULL AND museum != '' AND material IS NOT NULL AND material != '' GROUP BY museum, material
SELECT type AS source, material AS target, COUNT(*) AS value FROM artifact WHERE type IS NOT NULL AND type != '' AND material IS NOT NULL AND material != '' GROUP BY type, material

SELECT museum_id AS museumId, object_id AS objectId, title, artist, dynasty, type, material, museum, location, image_url AS imageUrl, image_path AS imagePath FROM artifact WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR artist LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dynasty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 30
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artifact WHERE dynasty IS NULL OR dynasty = ''

SELECT museum_id AS museumId, object_id AS objectId, title, artist, dynasty, type, material, museum, location, image_url AS imageUrl, image_path AS imagePath FROM artifact WHERE dynasty IS NULL OR dynasty = '' LIMIT 50
